summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Roth Capital Partners and H.C. Wainwright for an at-the-market offering of up to $30 million of ordinary shares. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under an existing F-3 registration statement, with a 3.0% agent commission and proceeds for working capital. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. This is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation.
